===== paired-round2.py SHA256=de24d5b90ab78f5f99b855de2387b827036fcb2954abd5784856d4645422be99 =====
from pathlib import Path
import datetime, hashlib, json, os, re, subprocess, sys

root=Path.cwd(); out=root/'.cache/low-copy'
env=dict(os.environ,CGO_ENABLED='0',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOAMD64='v1',GOMAXPROCS='16',GOFLAGS='-buildvcs=false')
paths=['baseline.test','round2-candidate.test','reference.test','stream-baseline.test','round2-stream-candidate.test']
provenance={'round':'2: identical put helpers appended after operations/resources; round1 rejected SQL/stream guards','gc_environment':{k:os.environ.get(k,'unset (Go default)') for k in ['GOGC','GOMEMLIMIT']},'time_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'phase0_checkpoint':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'go':subprocess.check_output(['/usr/lib64/go/1.26/bin/go','version'],text=True).strip(),'affinity':sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0)),'conditions':'Isolated alternating pairs/triples; 7x500ms; same Go1.26.8 CGO0 GOAMD64v1 PGOoff; default GC/memory; unpinned. Original workloads serial/initial P16; matched leaves actual P1; resource/stream contention leaves P1/P16 asserted; no builds/lint/fuzz/reviewer tools.','sha256':{p:hashlib.sha256((out/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}}
(out/'round2-paired-provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\n')
(out/'round2-candidate.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--binary']))
def sample(family,role,selector,round_number,duration='500ms'):
    binary=out/((('round2-' if role=='candidate' else '')+('stream-' if family.startswith('stream') else '')+role+'.test'))
    args=[str(binary),'-test.run=^$','-test.bench='+selector,'-test.benchtime='+duration,'-test.count=1','-test.benchmem']
    result=subprocess.run(args,env=env,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
    rows=[line for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith('Benchmark')]
    assert len(rows)==1,(family,role,selector,rows,result.stdout)
    fields=rows[0].split()
    if family!='original':
        metric='actual-procs'
        actual=float(fields[fields.index(metric)-1]); match=re.search(r'/P(\d+)/',fields[0]); expected=int(match.group(1)) if match else 1
        assert actual==expected,rows[0]
    with (out/('round2-'+family+'-'+role+'.txt')).open('a') as log:
        print('ROUND',round_number,datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),file=log)
        print('COMMAND',json.dumps(args),file=log)
        print(result.stdout,file=log,flush=True)
def selector(*segments): return '/'.join('^'+segment+'$' for segment in segments)
original=['ObfuscateSQL','SketchAdd','SketchAddMany1k','ObfuscateTraces1k','ObfuscateSQLVaried','SketchAddVaried','SketchAddNegativeBins']
for number in range(1,8):
    roles=['baseline','candidate','reference'] if number%2 else ['reference','candidate','baseline']
    for name in original:
        for role in roles: sample('original',role,'^Benchmark'+name+'$',number)
    print('complete',number,'original',flush=True)
    for corpus in ['Repeated','Nearby','Unique','NegativeBins','Holdout']:
        for size in [1,32,1024,8192]:
            query=selector('BenchmarkSketchMatchedBatch',corpus,'N'+str(size),'Facade')
            for role in roles: sample('matched',role,query,number)
    print('complete',number,'matched',flush=True)
    paired=roles if number%2 else roles
    paired=[r for r in paired if r!='reference']
    for processors,homes in [(1,1),(16,1),(16,16)]:
        for size in [32,1024]:
            query=selector('BenchmarkSketchBatchContention','P'+str(processors),'H'+str(homes),'N'+str(size),'Facade')
            for role in paired: sample('contention',role,query,number)
    print('complete',number,'contention',flush=True)
    for corpus in ['Fixed','Holdout']:
        for processors in [1,16]:
            for chunk in [64,4096]:
                query=selector('BenchmarkStreamStandalone',corpus,'P'+str(processors),'Chunk'+str(chunk),'Retain32')
                for role in paired: sample('stream-default',role,query,number)
        for path in ['StandaloneHomesP','BatchHomes1','BatchHomesP']:
            query=selector('BenchmarkStreamChecked',corpus,'P16','Chunk64','N32',path)
            for role in paired: sample('stream-checked',role,query,number)
    print('complete',number,'stream',flush=True)
print('paired qualification complete',flush=True)

===== qualify-round2.py SHA256=194f497663075ba170ebbb63727aff7350cd16eb0f1a0bcc8657d193b7362b3d =====
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, os, hashlib, json, re
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'.cache/low-copy'
env=dict(os.environ,CGO_ENABLED='0',GOTOOLCHAIN='local',GOCACHE=str(root/'.cache/go'),GOFLAGS='-buildvcs=false',GOLANGCI_LINT_CACHE=str(root/'.cache/lint'),RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN='1.97.0')
env['PATH']=str(root/'.cache/binaryen/binaryen-version_133/bin')+':'+os.path.expanduser('~/.cargo/bin')+':/usr/bin:'+env['PATH']
def run(name,args,runenv=env):
 with (out/('round2-'+name+'.log')).open('w') as log:
  print('COMMAND',json.dumps(args),file=log,flush=True)
  subprocess.run(args,env=runenv,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
 print('PASS',name,flush=True)
run('generator',['/usr/bin/go','test','./internal/gen/gogen','-count=1'])
for name in ['testdata/compute','examples/datadog','testdata/streaming']:
 run('build-'+name.split('/')[-1],['/usr/bin/go','run','./cmd/cocoon','build','--manifest',name+'/cocoon.toml'])
paths=['testdata/compute/go/compute/cocoon_gen.go','examples/datadog/go/dd/cocoon_gen.go','testdata/streaming/go/streaming/cocoon_gen.go']
def helpers(source):
 result={}
 for start in re.finditer(r'(?m)^func putSlice\w+\(',source):
  end=source.index('\n}\n',start.start())+3
  result[source[start.start():source.index('(',start.start())]]=source[start.start():end]
 return result
for path in paths:
 assert helpers((root/path).read_text())==helpers((out/'round1-source'/path).read_text()),path
 print('PASS unchanged helper bodies',path,flush=True)
linter=str(root/'.cache/sessions-phase0/golangci-lint-2.13.1-linux-amd64/golangci-lint')
for gate in ['check','race','rust','cross','smoke','fuzz','integration']:
 run('gate-'+gate,['make',gate,'GOLANGCI_LINT='+linter])
run('proof-reproduce',['python3',str(out/'reproduce-proofs.py')])
measure=dict(env,GOAMD64='v1',GOMAXPROCS='16')
for role,pkg in [('candidate','./examples/datadog/go/dd'),('stream-candidate','./testdata/streaming/go/streaming')]:
 run(role+'-compile',['/usr/lib64/go/1.26/bin/go','test','-c','-pgo=off','-o',str(out/('round2-'+role+'.test')),pkg],measure)
run('dd-oracle',[str(out/'round2-candidate.test'),'-test.run=^TestMatched','-test.bench=^BenchmarkSketch(MatchedBatch|BatchContention)$','-test.benchtime=1x','-test.count=1'],measure)
run('compute-go126',['/usr/lib64/go/1.26/bin/go','test','./testdata/compute/go/compute','-count=1'],measure)
print('round2 qualification and freeze complete',flush=True)

===== reproduce-proofs.py SHA256=4a123ba16672cb6cfc27fae81641c5f75ba88f97c9f57d15a41058e519384090 =====
import os, hashlib, json, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
out = root / '.cache/low-copy'
env = dict(os.environ, GOTOOLCHAIN='local', CGO_ENABLED='0', GOCACHE=str(root/'.cache/go'), GOFLAGS='-buildvcs=false')
env['PATH'] = str(root/'.cache/binaryen/binaryen-version_133/bin')+':'+env['PATH']
roots = ['testdata/compute', 'examples/datadog', 'testdata/streaming', 'rt/instance.go']
paths = subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--cached','--others','--exclude-standard','--',*roots],text=True).splitlines()
def fingerprints():
    return {p:hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
expected = fingerprints()
(out/'proof-reproduce-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(expected,indent=2)+'\n')
with (out/'proof-reproduce.log').open('w') as log:
    for number in (1,2):
        for manifest in ['testdata/compute/cocoon.toml','examples/datadog/cocoon.toml','testdata/streaming/cocoon.toml']:
            args=['/usr/bin/go','run','./cmd/cocoon','build','--manifest',manifest]
            print('Repeat',number,' '.join(args),file=log,flush=True)
            subprocess.run(args,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
        subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/go','generate','./rt'],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,check=True)
        actual=fingerprints()
        assert actual == expected, {p:(expected.get(p),actual.get(p)) for p in paths if expected.get(p)!=actual.get(p)}
        print('PASS: all',len(paths),'candidate proof/runtime files reproduce byte-for-byte in repeat',number,file=log,flush=True)
(out/'proof-reproduce-after.json').write_text(json.dumps(fingerprints(),indent=2)+'\n')
print('PASS: two repeated builds of all three proofs and runtime adapters; '+str(len(paths))+' files unchanged',flush=True)
